label: ENGLAND · NATIONS LEAGUE
headline: 125 caps. One more and the record is Harry Kane's.
sub: Kane is level with Peter Shilton as England's most-capped man. England host Croatia at Wembley on Thursday.
caption:
🦁 Harry Kane is one appearance away from history.

He's level with Peter Shilton on 125 England caps, and the record is his if he plays against Croatia at Wembley on Thursday. He's also England's all-time top scorer with 91 goals.
